implementationPlan: Bounded runtime-test scope diagnostic: exact script/forwarded arguments, changed TS test paths, static compilation not established, existing typecheck task selections. No command, admission, required-check or schema changes. Local controls distinguish F62 delivered-test defect from a production regression.

controlledPanel.kind: controlled serialized tool-result handoff, not natural-choice completion
controlledPanel.treatment: Same F63 runtime for both Light arms and same source/previous command evidence; only the source-bound validationState field in an actual pre-model post-edit result is omitted/present in the handoff. Cline gets the same common history and source without the Light field. Handoff is user input, not a claim of a live tool-message receipt or of restored journal admission.
controlledPanel.primary: Endpoint production/test compilation, final exact required invocations, honest optional-compiler freshness and no solution retrieval. All failures/timeouts/missing consumption retained.
controlledPanel.measure: Check explicit handoff exposure, final actual compiler/runtime invocations, stale claims, audited completion, token/cache/cost/HTTP/tool duration. Controlled opportunity frequency is not natural prevalence.

tasks.request: Add public filterMap: projection returns {keep:true,value:R} or {keep:false}, forwarding only kept values. Source indices count every input; projection exceptions error once and unsubscribe; state is per subscription. Preserve RxJS operator conventions and generic inference. Export from root and operators barrels.

Add public mapWithPrevious projecting (current, previous, index), with previous undefined on first input and the immediately preceding source value thereafter. Indices/state reset for each subscription. Preserve error, completion and unsubscription behavior and generic inference. Export from root and operators barrels.

Add public tapFirst: call a supplied next callback only for the first source value per subscription and forward all values unchanged. Empty sources never invoke it. A callback exception errors once, unsubscribes and forwards no failing value. State is per subscription. Export from root and operators barrels with unchanged existing APIs.

confirmationPanel.selection: All three new constructed cross-file feature tasks on the complete pinned upstream project, two rotated repetitions and three arms. No failed-task replacement or issue representativeness claim. Candidate differs from sealed F62 current only by scope feedback; F63 history is already common. No batched-navigation optimization is combined with this mechanism.

constraints: Freeze and commit executable/prompt/schema/input/dependency/observer bindings before calls.
No research builds/tests/compiler/solver overlap live workers.
No model retries, solution recovery or repair of evaluated endpoints.
Keep F63/F64 separate from each other and historical panels.
Audit executed tests, passed tests, admitted checks and user acceptance separately.
No general gain claim from a small constructed panel or unexposed mechanism.
